data: Which of the plots shows an horizontal line crossed by a red line?

The question asks which plot shows an horizontal line crossed by a red line. From the caption, we know that the horizontal axis represents node degrees \( k \), and the vertical axis shows the values \( 1 - F(k) \), where \( F(k) \) is a distribution function of node degrees. 

Looking at the two graphs:

1. In graph (a), there is no horizontal line crossed by a red line. The data points follow a downward trend along a curve, and there is no horizontal line present.

2. In graph (b), there is a horizontal line (the x-axis) that is crossed by a red line (the fitted line).

Therefore, the plot that shows an horizontal line crossed by a red line is graph (b).
